content.short: Convex Finance is a boosted yield optimizer for Curve Finance's CRV tokens.
content.description: Convex Finance is a platform for CRV holders and Curve liquidity providers to boost their rewards by participating in liquidity mining on Curve Finance. By aggregating Curve liquidity positions, Convex lets providers earn higher CRV rewards without locking their own CRV tokens. The native CVX token is issued pro rata for each CRV token claimed by Curve liquidity providers, aligning incentives and enabling scalable yield enhancement across supported networks.
